name: Skinner v4.0.4 — Crisp KO Previews, Unified Weapon Studio & Performance Polish
changelog: Lockout During Loading: Prevented tab switching and settings modal access while assets are preloading.
Comprehensive Asset Preload: Preloading expanded across all weapon skins, costumes, legends, and knockout effects.
Buttery Smooth Window Dragging: Optimized batch IPC scheduling to maintain 60fps window drag and resize responsiveness.
Crisp Single-Frame KO Previews: Fixed animation frame stacking to render sharp, iconic midpoint frames without smoke distortion.
Unified Weapon Customizer: Matched layout, cards grid (repeat 2, 1fr), and controls 1:1 with KO Effects Studio.
Fixed Target Weapon Selection: Fixed CardPickerModal item selection callback bug so target weapon reliably updates.
Zero Glow Artifacts: Completely removed fuzzy box shadows and glows from toggle switches and primary buttons.
Cryptographic Verification: All release binaries signed with Ed25519 and verified via SHA-256 manifests.
